skills.name: Bulwark Charge
skills.description: Dash 6 blocks forward, knocking back every enemy you pass 4 blocks and gaining Resistance II for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Iron Retort
skills.description: For 6 seconds, every melee hit you take deals 50% of its damage back to the attacker and knocks it back 3 blocks.

skills.name: Honjin Ring
skills.description: Allies within 6 blocks gain Resistance I and Speed I for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Kesa Guard
skills.description: Strike the creature you look at within 4 blocks, then gain absorption equal to the damage dealt for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Shieldbreaker Roar
skills.description: Roar in a 6-block cone, applying Weakness II and Slowness I to enemies for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Bloodied Bulwark
skills.description: For 8 seconds gain Resistance I and +1 attack damage for every 2 hearts you are missing.

skills.name: Temple Bell
skills.description: Ring a bell: enemies within 5 blocks are stunned for 2 seconds and pushed back 4 blocks.

skills.name: Stone Lotus Pose
skills.description: Root yourself for 6 seconds, gaining Resistance III and healing 1 heart per second.

skills.name: Cinder Rampart
skills.description: Raise a 5-wide, 2-tall magma block wall for 8 seconds that sets enemies touching it on fire.

skills.name: Hearth Ward
skills.description: For 6 seconds a 4-block area grants allies Fire Resistance and Regeneration I and ignites enemies for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Rime Dome
skills.description: Encase yourself in a packed-ice shelter for 10 seconds, gaining Regeneration I while inside.

skills.name: Shatterguard
skills.description: For 8 seconds, enemies that hit you in melee are frozen for 3 seconds and given Slowness III.

skills.name: Breakwater
skills.description: Release a wave ring that pushes enemies within 6 blocks back 5 blocks and gives allies Resistance I for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Undertow Anchor
skills.description: Mark a target for 6 seconds: it has Slowness II and is pulled 1 block toward you every second.

skills.name: Faraday Cage
skills.description: Surround yourself with an iron bar cage for 8 seconds; enemies touching it are struck by lightning.

skills.name: Static Bulwark
skills.description: For 8 seconds, each hit you take stuns the attacker for 1 second and arcs 4 damage to one nearby enemy.

skills.name: Consecrated Ground
skills.description: Bless a 5-block area for 6 seconds, healing allies 1 heart per second and burning undead for 2 damage per second.

skills.name: Oath of Shelter
skills.description: For 8 seconds, half the damage allies within 6 blocks take is transferred to you instead.

skills.name: Obsidian Pact
skills.description: Raise a 5-wide, 3-tall crying obsidian wall in front of you for 10 seconds.

skills.name: Hollow Aegis
skills.description: For 6 seconds, 50% of damage you take is redirected as magic damage to the nearest enemy within 8 blocks.

skills.name: Ossuary Wall
skills.description: Raise a 5-wide bone block wall for 10 seconds; when it crumbles it releases 3 allied skeletons.

skills.name: Grave Pact
skills.description: Mark a target; if it dies within 10 seconds you gain Absorption II for 10 seconds and an allied zombie bodyguard.

skills.name: Briar Hedge
skills.description: Grow a 5-wide hedge of sweet berry bushes for 12 seconds that slows and pricks enemies walking through it.

skills.name: Acorn of Plenty
skills.description: Conjure an acorn that, when eaten, grants Absorption II and Resistance I for 30 seconds.

skills.name: Mirror Bulwark
skills.description: For 6 seconds, projectiles that hit you deal no damage and their shooter takes that damage instead.

skills.name: Balanced Seal
skills.description: Enemies within 5 blocks lose 4 armour and allies within 5 blocks gain 4 armour for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Ancestral Watch
skills.description: Summon 3 allied vexes that guard you for 15 seconds and soulburn enemies they hit.

skills.name: Ancestor's Shroud
skills.description: For 8 seconds, the first lethal hit leaves you at 1 heart and soulburns the attacker for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Duskward
skills.description: For 6 seconds, when hit you blink behind the attacker and gain Strength I for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Night Watch
skills.description: Enemies within 8 blocks glow for 10 seconds and you become invisible for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Shackle Strike
skills.description: Strike the creature you look at, applying Slowness IV and Weakness I for 5 seconds and stealing one of its positive effects.

skills.name: Collateral
skills.description: Mark a target for 15 seconds; if it dies it drops an extra loot roll and you gain Absorption II for 10 seconds.

skills.name: Pavise
skills.description: Raise a 3-wide, 2-tall oak plank wall in front of you for 10 seconds and gain Resistance I while within 3 blocks of it.

skills.name: Iron Quarrel
skills.description: Throw a heavy bolt that deals 8 damage, pierces up to 3 enemies and knocks each back 2 blocks.

skills.name: Errant Charge
skills.description: Dash 8 blocks, dealing 6 damage and knockback to enemies you pass; damage is doubled while mounted.

skills.name: Banner of the Road
skills.description: Plant a banner; for 8 seconds allies within 5 blocks regain 1 hunger per second and have Resistance I.

skills.name: Kanabo Crush
skills.description: Strike the creature you look at for heavy damage, stunning it for 2 seconds.

skills.name: Tetsubo Sweep
skills.description: Swing in a 3-block ring, knocking all enemies back 4 blocks and giving them Slowness II for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Red Harvest
skills.description: For 10 seconds, each kill grants one more level of Strength, stacking up to Strength III.

skills.name: Thrown Hatchet
skills.description: Throw an axe that deals 7 damage and makes the target bleed for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Tsuppari Barrage
skills.description: Hit the creature you look at with 5 palm strikes over 2 seconds, each pushing it back 1 block.

skills.name: Chanko Nabe
skills.description: Conjure a hotpot that, when eaten, grants Health Boost II and Resistance I for 60 seconds.

skills.name: Slag Hammer
skills.description: Strike the creature you look at, setting it on fire for 6 seconds and giving it Slowness III for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Bellows Blast
skills.description: Blast a 6-block cone of fire that knocks enemies back 4 blocks and ignites them for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Avalanche Stomp
skills.description: Leap up to 6 blocks and land with a shockwave that freezes enemies within 4 blocks for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Glacier Boulder
skills.description: Throw an ice boulder dealing 8 damage and Slowness III for 5 seconds to enemies within 2 blocks of impact.

skills.name: Abyssal Maw
skills.description: Open a 6-block vortex for 4 seconds that pulls enemies 1 block toward you each second and deals 2 damage per pulse.

skills.name: Brine Roar
skills.description: Roar in a 6-block cone, giving enemies Slowness II and Weakness I for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Thunderclap
skills.description: Clap a shockwave dealing 6 damage to enemies within 5 blocks, knocking them back and giving Nausea for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Overcharge
skills.description: Gain Speed II and Haste II for 8 seconds; when it ends, discharge 8 damage to enemies within 4 blocks.

skills.name: Holy Hammer
skills.description: Throw a hammer that deals 7 damage, doubled against undead, and stuns the target for 1 second.

skills.name: Righteous Fervor
skills.description: For 8 seconds your melee hits heal you for 20% of the damage dealt and set undead on fire for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Void Lash
skills.description: Lash a 5-block cone, applying Wither II and Darkness to enemies for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Abyssal Mutation
skills.description: For 10 seconds gain Health Boost III and Strength I, but suffer Darkness.

skills.name: Offal Feast
skills.description: Conjure raw offal that, when eaten, heals 6 hearts and grants Strength I for 20 seconds.

skills.name: Carrion Cage
skills.description: Mark a target; when it dies it bursts, damaging enemies within 4 blocks and healing you 2 hearts per enemy hit.

skills.name: Fault Line
skills.description: Send a ground shockwave 8 blocks ahead that launches enemies 3 blocks up and slows them for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Overgrowth Roots
skills.description: Entangle a 5-block area for 5 seconds, giving enemies Slowness V and 1 damage per second.

skills.name: Jade Rampage
skills.description: Dash 6 blocks, shattering 3 armour from every enemy you pass for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Symmetry Slam
skills.description: Strike the creature you look at; the same damage is mirrored onto the nearest other enemy within 6 blocks.

skills.name: Demon Mask
skills.description: For 10 seconds gain Strength II while enemies within 4 blocks have Weakness I.

skills.name: Soulfire Kanabo
skills.description: Strike the creature you look at, soulburning it for 6 seconds; if it dies burning, enemies within 3 blocks catch soulburn.

skills.name: Headsman's Verdict
skills.description: Strike the creature you look at for triple damage if it is below 30% health, otherwise make it bleed for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Marked for the Block
skills.description: Mark a target for 10 seconds: it glows and takes 25% more damage; killing it resets this cooldown.

skills.name: Shakedown
skills.description: Strike the creature you look at, knocking it back 4 blocks and making it drop its held item.

skills.name: Back-Alley Brawl
skills.description: Hit every enemy within 3 blocks, gaining 1 absorption heart for each enemy hit.

skills.name: Blubber Ration
skills.description: Conjure blubber that, when eaten, grants Resistance I and Water Breathing for 2 minutes.

skills.name: Flensing Strike
skills.description: Strike the creature you look at, making it bleed and glow for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Goat Ram
skills.description: Summon 2 allied goats for 15 seconds that ram enemies, knocking them back 5 blocks.

skills.name: Alpine Bellow
skills.description: Allies and mounts within 8 blocks gain Speed II and Jump Boost II for 10 seconds.

skills.name: Kirisute Dash
skills.description: Dash 5 blocks, cutting every enemy you pass and making them bleed for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Shura Mode
skills.description: For 8 seconds deal 40% more damage but take 20% more; each kill heals you 3 hearts.

skills.name: Zanshin
skills.description: For 8 seconds, each time you are hit your next melee strike deals 6 extra damage.

skills.name: Ki Slash
skills.description: Throw a ki crescent that travels 12 blocks, dealing 7 damage to every enemy it passes through.

skills.name: Burning Sheath
skills.description: For 8 seconds your hits ignite targets, and every third hit explodes for 4 damage within 2 blocks.

skills.name: Kagu Flare
skills.description: Leap 5 blocks backward, leaving a 3-block trail of fire behind you.

skills.name: Hyoga Draw
skills.description: Strike the creature you look at, freezing it for 4 seconds; already frozen targets take double damage.

skills.name: Snowfall Step
skills.description: Dash 6 blocks, leaving a line of powder snow behind you for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Rain Curtain
skills.description: Call rain on a 5-block area for 6 seconds, giving allies Regeneration I and enemies Slowness I.

skills.name: Carp Leap
skills.description: Leap 6 blocks upward, gaining Slow Falling and Dolphin's Grace for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Kaminari Sheath
skills.description: For 8 seconds your critical hits call down lightning on the target.

skills.name: Inazuma Mark
skills.description: Mark a target; when it dies, lightning chains to 3 enemies within 6 blocks for 6 damage each.

skills.name: Sun Disk
skills.description: Throw a radiant disk dealing 7 damage that sets undead on fire and makes the target glow for 10 seconds.

skills.name: Dawnbreak
skills.description: Flash light in a 6-block ring, blinding enemies for 4 seconds and healing allies 3 hearts.

skills.name: Cleaving Hex
skills.description: Mark a target for 8 seconds; every hit on it also deals 3 damage to enemies within 3 blocks of it.

skills.name: Cursed Womb
skills.description: Summon 4 allied endermites for 12 seconds whose bites inflict Wither I.

skills.name: Fallen Retainer
skills.description: Summon an allied wither skeleton bodyguard for 20 seconds whose hits make enemies bleed.

skills.name: Crimson Toll
skills.description: Strike the creature you look at, dealing all its remaining bleed damage at once and healing you that much.
